item.title: rubygem-safemode Compound-Assignment Jail Allow-List Bypass (CVE-2026-107360)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.6) — web · CVE-2026-107360 (RHSA-2026:99949, RHSA-2026:99950, RHSA-2026:99952, RHSA-2026:100120). Status: Weaponized (differential lab executes the bypass against safemode 2.0.3 and blocks it on the PR #75 fix; not executed while preparing this entry). Affects: rubygem-safemode, the sandboxed template evaluator used by Foreman and Red Hat Satellite 6. Tags: sandbox escape, template injection, Ruby, safemode, Foreman, Red Hat Satellite, CWE-183, authenticated, compound assignment.
